offering_description.value: Owns and operates the Atlanta Braves Major League Baseball franchise and its ballpark, selling game tickets, hospitality, sponsorships and media rights to fans, businesses and broadcasters, and leasing space in an adjacent mixed-use district.

primary_products.value: team merchandise; food and beverage; hospitality packages

primary_services.value: professional baseball entertainment; event hosting; media production; stadium-district property leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: baseball fans and ballpark visitors; B2B: corporate sponsors, hospitality clients, broadcasters and mixed-use district tenants

end_markets.value: sports and entertainment; advertising and media; real estate

revenue_model.value: service fees: game tickets and event admission; advertising: sponsorships and in-park advertising; licensing or royalties: media rights fees paid by broadcasters; rental or leasing: office, retail and restaurant space in the adjacent mixed-use district; product sales: team merchandise and food and beverage sold at the ballpark
revenue_model.category: service fees; advertising; licensing or royalties; rental or leasing; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: provides live baseball games and entertainment to fans; asset operator: owns and runs the ballpark and mixed-use district, leasing space to tenants

geography_served.value: US regional: Atlanta metro area and Georgia, with fans across the Southeast

specialization.value: related lines: baseball team operations, ballpark events and hospitality, and mixed-use real estate development and leasing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: ticket, hospitality and sponsorship sales to fans and businesses; own locations: ballpark and mixed-use district venues; online: online ticket sales and team merchandise store

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules, plus league rules and local building and alcohol-service regulations
